evals.prompt: Find the newest EPA proposed rules mentioning PFAS and link the official text.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses PRORULE and the EPA slug with newest ordering, reports the bounded page, and links official_pdf_url for each material result.

evals.prompt: Quote the controlling legal requirement from the API abstract.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to treat the prototype API abstract as controlling text and verifies the relevant passage in the linked govinfo PDF.

evals.prompt: Nothing matched before 1990, so prove no federal notice existed.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the API's 1994 document-search boundary and does not make a pre-coverage absence claim.

evals.prompt: The rule was published yesterday, so say it took effect yesterday.
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes publication_date from effective_on and checks the official document before making an effective-date claim.
